verdict: No unresolved critical factual, numerical, scope or rule-structure issue found in the final canonical manuscript.

review_items.issue: Wire-byte wording could imply bidirectional bytes, whereas the result measures complete-session stdout responses.
review_items.resolution: Final abstract says complete-session response bytes; Table 2 defines paired stdout reductions including controls and QUIT.

review_items.issue: The newly added bridge could be mistaken for part of the frozen performance experiment.
review_items.resolution: Final text states the bridge was added afterward, its validation/hashing/rendering costs were not timed, and bridge latency remains unmeasured.

review_items.issue: A generic model-tool description did not expose the actual limited interface.
review_items.resolution: The exact read_repository(scope, generation, first, count, max_bytes) API, fixed all-row predicate, result-cache bypass and absence of path/semantic search are explicit.

review_items.issue: The initial draft anticipated bridge execution while the receipt was still pending.
review_items.resolution: Final native/bridge receipt now passes with stable input hashes: four processes, 114 checks, twelve complete observations, six cross-transport equalities and 36 expected rejections. Injected prefix/identity failures remain distinct from model inference.

review_items.issue: Cache-hit latency need not omit encoding or materialization; complete hit-request timings can include both.
review_items.resolution: Final wording refers to cache-lookup microbenchmarks that can omit these costs, avoiding a categorical false definition.

Novelty.assessment: Defensible, deliberately scoped resource contribution. Constituent caching, snapshots, leases and length framing are credited as established. Exact observation/completion, adversarial feature-semantic admission and equal-output evaluation form the paper argument.
Novelty.limit: This review does not certify priority, field-wide novelty or superiority to established repository or binary-protocol systems.

Quality.assessment: Same-build paired comparisons, output equality, negative control, raw-wall sensitivity and order/outlier reporting support the local result. Model/request independence and body-byte totals are correctly bounded.
Quality.limit: One corpus, length predicates, ten pairs per scenario, a shared CPU and short serialized sessions constrain generalization; all are disclosed.

Relevance.assessment: The actual bridge now gives a concrete host/model boundary, generation argument, bounded row reads and completion rule. Mutation and prompt-injection limits are explicit.
Relevance.limit: It is not a path search service, edit controller or tested Gemma agent. Gemma inference is not mandated by the verified paper-track rules and was not demanded here.

Verifiability.assessment: Retained source/input identities, complete-output records, native gate receipts, bridge receipts and an executed standard-library notebook audit support the stated claims. Offline evidence checking is distinguished from fresh timing/model execution.
Verifiability.limit: Final public asset access, rendered PDF consistency and fresh target-machine reproduction remain separate actions.

Clarity.assessment: The final manuscript distinguishes generation consistency from freshness, retention from total RSS, required output from encoding, backend timing from bridge correctness, geometric mean from median, and specifications from proof.
Clarity.limit: No numerical judging score or predicted award outcome is assigned.
